placeholders.{objectTypeId.quote}: objectTypeId in the response of the create-schema request for this object (schemas.json).
placeholders.{objectTypeId.order}: objectTypeId in the response of the create-schema request for this object (schemas.json).

body.name: quote
body.description: One request for quote (RFQ) and the quote sent in reply: what was asked for, the price, the lead time and the outcome. Sales handling, so it sits apart from the order that follows.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Company and a short description of the request, for example the product family.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.quote}.

body.name: order
body.description: One customer purchase order accepted by the business. Tracks acknowledgement, dispatch and payment. This is the delivery side. It stays separate from the quote and the deal.

properties.name: name
properties.label: Name
properties.description: Company and the customer's purchase order number.

requests.note: Needs Enterprise. Save objectTypeId from the response as {objectTypeId.order}.
